t: What the Qur'an says it treats
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
p: Yā ayyuha-n-nāsu qad jā'atkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum wa shifā'un limā fi-ṣ-ṣudūri wa hudan wa raḥmatun li-l-mu'minīn.
m: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
